critical_gaps: No trained XRP-specific candidate prediction model exists.
No synchronized historical spot/L2/derivatives/flows/collateral dataset has been admitted.
No independent WORM archive or trusted timestamp anchor is implemented.
The xrp-public-ingestion workflow exists only on integration; main does not contain it and no main ingestion run exists.

The walk-forward integration assigns a source_group_id only when the forecast's source_independence_groups list has exactly one member; with multiple groups it passes null. With one group, the bootstrap still has only one cluster, below its five-cluster minimum. Therefore the source-clustered CI is never estimable through the current walk-forward path.

The forecast ledger does not require paired bootstrap intervals or multiplicity-adjusted uncertainty. It currently checks mean Brier/log-loss superiority against four baselines, calibration, drift, OOS/shadow counts, effective sample size, provenance and independent Ed25519 attestation.

The paired bootstrap currently compares each model against one configured benchmark; the walk-forward call uses naive_class_prior. It does not yet provide candidate-vs-each-of-four-baselines uncertainty as a readiness gate.
No independent shadow outcome cohort or demonstrated candidate-model superiority exists.
